info.title: AEGIS Backend
info.description: Crew health-aware mission planning prototype. All crew data is synthetic demo data. Open demo mode (default): no sign-in. Choose a persona from GET /api/v1/personas and send it as the X-AEGIS-User header (use Authorize above); without it you act as the mission leader.

get.description:
Everyone you can act as in open demo mode. No sign-in needed.

These are demonstration viewpoints, not security: they show how each role sees and does
different things (an astronaut sees only their own data; only the mission leader approves plans).
The persona (open mode) or signed-in user (token mode), and which astronauts they may see.

post.description:
Put all data back to the 49 seed CSVs (open demo mode only, as the mission leader persona).

Everything visitors changed is removed: simulation runs, plans, tests taken, reports, sync events.
Takes a few seconds.
Mission leader only. The mission starts empty; register its crew with POST /admin/users.
